package_cloud_executable: package a cloud executable from a container, dockerfile, python container, or bazel container spec
build_python_container_image: build a docker image from a PythonContainer spec and push it to Google Container Registry
build_dockerfile_image: build a docker image from a Dockerfile spec and push it to Google Container Registry
package_bazel_container_image: load a Bazel-built container image, tag it, and push it to Google Container Registry
package_existing_container: pull an existing container image, tag it for the project GCR, and push it to Google Container Registry
